debeziumServerModal.title: Create pipeline resources using Debezium server configuration
debeziumServerModal.description: Upload a Debezium server configuration file to auto create pipeline resources. On uploading a config file a source, transforms and a destination will be created synchronously based on the uploaded config and then finally you can create a pipeline using these resources.

pipelinePage.description: View and manage your configured pipelines. You can also create a new pipeline to stream change events from a source database.
pipelinePage.title: Pipeline
pipelinePage.welcomeDescription: Stage UI provide a visual tool to setup and operate with data pipelines where can you define the source, the destination, and any data transformations.
pipelinePage.welcomeDescriptionSufix: Add a pipeline to stream change event from a pipeline source database. To create a pipeline, you can select an already configured or add a new source and destination.
pipelinePage.designerDescription: Create a pipeline by selecting an existing source and destination, or create new ones as if needed. You can optionally add one or more transformations to apply to the pipeline.

transformDrawer.description: List of transform to be applied to pipeline you can delete or rearrange them on specific order for them to be applied.
transformDrawer.title: Transform list
transformDrawer.emptyState: No transform added to the pipeline

form.title: Pipeline configuration
form.description: To configure and create a data pipeline fill out the below form or use the smart editor to setup a new data pipeline. If you already have a configuration file, you can setup a new data pipeline by uploading it in the smart editor.
form.descriptionFieldHelperText: Add a one liner to describe your pipeline or what you plan to capture.
form.logLevelSectionDescription: Add custom log levels for specific packages

validation.nameMaxLength: Pipeline name must be 253 characters or fewer.
validation.nameRfc1123: Pipeline name must be lowercase and use only letters, numbers, '-' or '.'.

overview.description: Pipeline overview for {{val}} with list of essential metrics, composition (source & destination) details, pipeline logs and option to edit pipeline.
overview.title: Pipeline overview

monitoring.title: Pipeline Monitoring
monitoring.description: Monitor your pipeline performance and metrics in real-time.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Use signaling to perform actions on the pipeline.
actions.collectionFieldDescription: A required component of the data field of a signal that specifies an array of collection names or regular expressions to match collection names to include in the snapshot.
actions.messageFieldDescription: The message parameter specifies the string to print to the log. If you add a placeholder ({ }) to the message, it is replaced with streaming coordinates.
actions.actionTypeFieldDescription: Specifies type parameter specifies the operation that the signal is intended to trigger.
actions.actionIdHelper: Its prefilled with UUID string, user can also update it to provide their own ID.

filterConditionFields.filtersHelperText: Specifies the column values that must be present in a data collection record for the snapshot to include it.
filterConditionFields.collectionsHelperText: The fully-qualified name of the data collection for which the filter will be applied.

actions.additioanlConditionsDesc: Additional conditions that the connector evaluates to determine the subset of records to include in a snapshot.
